frequency_question: How often does the Federal Reserve complete the entire procedural pipeline for a capital buffer change within a short time horizon (under 60 days) once initiated?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Board of Governors policy action modifying the countercyclical capital buffer framework or setting its rate; excludes routine supervisory guidance that does not alter capital requirements.
provenance_note: claims 40 cases from only 4 named (10.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 40 observed policy review windows under the post-crisis capital framework; zero instances of the buffer being raised above 0%.
known_gaps: Internal staff deliberations prior to formal public calendars are not fully timestamped.
skeleton: Regulatory review cycles (Board data aggregation + staff memo + inter-division consultation + scheduled Board meeting vote)
multiplier: 4 quarterly scheduled supervisory review windows per year over 10 years equals 40 observation opportunities, with 0 active buffer increases above 0% executed due to prevailing framework calibration.
validity_reason: The statutory and regulatory machinery governing Federal Reserve capital rules remains stable under current Dodd-Frank architectures.
